# 🪪 AGR-071 · `quiz-generation-verified`

> Generate items, critic solves them blind to verify keys.

| Card ID | Domain | Pattern | Nodes | Edges | Verifiers | Routers | Max steps | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR-071` | education | **generator-critic** | 4 | 4 | 1 | 0 | 10 | execute |

> 🎯 **Requires a goal** — the source material to quiz on and the level of the learners. Without one the graph refuses and runs no node.

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Generate items, critic solves them blind to verify keys.

## Why it should deliver results

The generator optimizes for recall, the critic for precision. Nothing is accepted until the critic signs off, which filters out trivial, tautological, or hallucinated output before it ever reaches you.

- **Exit contract** — critic answers match keys; distractors plausible
- **Machine-checked** — `all(i.answer_matches_key and i.distractors_plausible for i in output.entries)`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 10 steps; every loop edge is condition-guarded
- **Golden cases** — `uv run agr eval quiz-generation-verified` replays recorded cases through the real edge/assert logic (mock runner proves mechanics; `--live` measures your model)
- **Trace gallery** — [every case's route, node outputs, and checked asserts](../../../docs/traces/quiz-generation-verified.md)

## How to work with it

```bash
uv run agr show quiz-generation-verified       # full definition
uv run agr profile quiz-generation-verified    # deterministic structural facts
uv run agr mermaid quiz-generation-verified    # regenerate the diagram below
uv run agr eval quiz-generation-verified       # run golden cases (add --live for your endpoint)
uv run agr adapt quiz-generation-verified --target langgraph > app.py   # compile to runnable LangGraph
uv run agr optimize quiz-generation-verified   # propose bounded structural improvements (dry-run)
```

Over MCP: `uv run agr mcp` exposes the registry (search / show / profile) to any MCP client.
To evolve it: `uv run agr infuse quiz-generation-verified <node> <ability>` — every mutation is gate-checked and appended to the graph's lineage log.

## Node roster

| Node | Speciality | Kind | Abilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intake` | analyst | agent | analyze |
| `generate` | producer | agent | generate |
| `blind-solve` | worker | agent | run_command |
| `critique` | critic | verifier | critique |

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `intake` | `generate` | always |
| `generate` | `blind-solve` | always |
| `blind-solve` | `critique` | always |
| `critique` | `generate` | rejected and attempts < 3 |

- **capacity-forecaster** (devops-sre, generator-critic) — Forecast load, critic stress-tests assumptions against history. *Verify:* backtest error within stated confidence band.
